{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales_df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check that parsing worked
print('Sample of parsed revenue:', sales_df['revenue'].head(5).tolist())

# Now, focus on the question: Among NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH, what fraction converted?
# Filter for new customers and paid_search channel
filtered_df = sales_df[
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & 
    (sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search')
]

# Check the filtered data
print('\nFiltered data shape:', filtered_df.shape)
print('\nConverted distribution in filtered group:\n', filtered_df['converted'].value_counts())

# Compute the fraction converted
fraction_converted = filtered_df['converted'].mean()

# Output result
fraction_converted"}
